Task under review: Task 1 of an audit-remediation plan — a dead-code purge (~35k lines, 185 files) in apps/app/src/features/mindmap/.

Read these three files first:
1. Requirements (the spec): .superpowers/sdd/task-1-brief.md
2. Implementer's report: .superpowers/sdd/task-1-report.md
3. Review package (commits, diffstat, full diffs of modified/added files; deleted-file bodies omitted intentionally): .superpowers/sdd/reviews/task-1-package.md

Global constraints binding this task:
- The live render path must survive: (site)/research-canvas/page.tsx → MindMap → ReactFlowProvider + MindMapProvider → ViewSwitcher(canvasContent=<Graph />) → views; live guided-tour files (tour-overlay, use-guided-tour, guided-tour-store, famous-events-tour) must survive; live hover-panels under components/menus/mindmap-side-menu/hover-panels/ must be untouched.
- "Improbable Moon" canon must be extracted to docs/design/ BEFORE the tour-definitions deletion (verify the file exists and has real narrative content, and that the extraction commit precedes or equals the deletion commit).
- Live-consumer edits must be minimal (remove dead dependency, no redesigns).
- Only the implementer's own paths staged (tree has foreign uncommitted changes — verify no foreign files were swept into commits: check the diffstat against the manifest scope; anything committed outside apps/app/src/features/mindmap/, apps/app/src/components (deleted consumers), apps/app/src/tests, docs/design/, and .superpowers/ deserves scrutiny).
- Two auditor contradictions (config/node-types.tsx, config/index.config.ts) had to be resolved with evidence, not guessed.

Review method:
1. Spec: walk manifest sections A-I in the brief against the report + diffstat. For each: fully done / partially done / skipped-with-valid-evidence / skipped-without-evidence. Missing requirements = spec ❌. Extra work beyond the spec = flag it.
2. Verify keep-list survival yourself: run `git show HEAD --stat` etc. or list the feature directory to confirm live files (graph.tsx, mind-map.tsx, ViewSwitcher, guided-tour files, mindmap-side-menu/hover-panels/, organizeNodeLayout.ts) still exist on disk.
3. Spot-check 3-4 of the riskiest live-consumer edits in the package diff (e.g. search.ts consumer edits in root-node-card / useEntity, test file edits, barrel fixes) for correctness and minimality.
4. Quality: assess the modified-file diffs for leftover dangling references, commented-out code left behind, or over-deletion. You may run `rg` to verify no references to deleted modules remain under apps/app/src.
5. Items you cannot verify from the package (e.g. whether a deleted file truly had zero consumers) — mark "⚠️ Cannot verify from diff" rather than guessing; the controller resolves those.

Report back (final message): Spec verdict (✅/❌ with per-section table), Quality verdict (Approved / Issues with severity Critical/Important/Minor, each with file:line), ⚠️ unverifiable items, one-paragraph summary.
